newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries ending dull session slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries ending dull session slightly lower.

text.p: *US Treasuries slightly lower, very quiet ahead of close *With no data, market sticks to narrow ranges. Tone bearish *Fears of strong CPI on Tuesday weighs on market, keeping many investors on sidelines. No impact from higher stocks, dollar *3-,6-month bill sale said well bid. GovPX volume $65 billion.
